name: Cursor Highlight
author: OpenPen
description: Adds a coloured glow that follows the cursor in screen shares and recordings, toggled from the control bar, plus an optional click ripple in drawing mode.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 游標周圍加上彩色光暈，分享螢幕時觀眾能一路跟上；可選點擊漣漪。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 游标周围加上彩色光晕，分享屏幕时观众能一路跟上；可选点击涟漪。

screenshots.alt: A yellow glow surrounds the cursor in a mail inbox.
The glow follows the cursor, then the panel changes its colour and size.

changelog: 1.0.1: Marketplace icon, cover image and Traditional and Simplified Chinese descriptions.
